children: Wei Zhu, through Bastion Trading Limited, Bastion Holdings Limited, and Lucio Holding Limited, disclosed a 9.99% stake in SkyAI, Inc. common stock. The Schedule 13D was filed on Sep. 03, 2026 amid growing tensions ahead of the company’s 2026 annual meeting. Zhu’s group cites governance and conflict-of-interest concerns and signals an effort to influence the board’s direction.

Zhu’s group plans to oppose the board at the 2026 annual meeting and said they "currently intend to vote their shares 'WITHHOLD ALL'" against the re-election of all five directors. They criticize SkyAI’s bylaw changes that curb shareholder rights, the board’s adoption of a poison pill without a shareholder vote, and related-party ties to firms linked to a director’s family.

They also flagged potential conflicts around payments to Sol Edge Limited and Sol Markets, saying they are "deeply concerned" about underperformance and governance. The group seeks a dialogue with the board and may adjust its position, while warrant terms cap effective ownership at 9.99% unless the cap is lifted.

Wei Zhu is a UK-based entrepreneur who leads proprietary trading and investment activities across Bastion Trading Limited, Bastion Holdings Limited, and Lucio Holding Limited. He serves as CFO and COO of Bastion Trading and Bastion Holdings and as the sole officer and director of Lucio Holding. Zhu focuses on event-driven and special-situation investments, including structured deals and activist engagements.
